items.title: Esther Dupuy Breckenridge Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: They had Johnny Detroit at some parties and was he at the Austin for a long time?

ctx.x: I guess it's a bit around the 30s or something like that.

I don't remember. It seems to me we always had very good colored bands down here. Most of the dances that I've ever been to up east. You know, when I went to those big debut parties up on Long Island, they had other the big name bands, Leo Reisman and all of those bands. But down here, I thought it really stuck pretty much to the colored bands. They had Johnny Detroit at some parties and was he at the Austin for a long time? Well, you wouldn't call him Dixieland Jazz, exactly.
